architecture.name: PreferenceAwareMambaNVP
architecture.candidate_encoder: shared program-conditioned two-layer Mamba candidate encoder
architecture.value_head: shared scalar head from candidate embedding
architecture.preference_head: MLP Linear(d_model,d_model), ReLU, Linear(d_model,1) over h_i-h_j

target_and_objective.preference_loss: balanced binary cross entropy over strict raw_candidate_value pairs

pair_sampling.strict_definition: raw_candidate_value_i != raw_candidate_value_j; ties never create a pair
pair_sampling.eligible_program_rule: program has at least one strict pair
pair_sampling.all_tie_program_rule: retain L_value; set L_preference=0; do not delete program
pair_sampling.construction: sample 5 strict winner/loser pairs then include each canonical positive orientation and its reversed negative orientation
pair_sampling.sampling_seed: seed-specific Torch RNG; resample candidate indices until strict

training.lr_schedule: 500-step linear warmup then cosine to lr*0.01 over remaining 9500 steps
training.checkpoint_selection_rule: maximum ValidationFinalMeanOverOz policy-45 dataset macro mean; deterministic first checkpoint on exact tie

validation.ranking: descending logits; candidate ID ascending tie break
